transcript_turns.content: Circuitway's forecasting module is accurate for customers with a single warehouse, but activation drops sharply for customers running more than three sites: only 34.7% of multi-site customers reach their first accurate forecast within 30 days, versus 81.2% of single-site customers. What do you do about the multi-site segment, which is 46% of the pipeline this quarter?

I'd ship the manual override tool this quarter rather than rebuilding the forecasting engine. Circuitway only has 2 backend engineers free and a board commitment to grow logos 25%, so a full model rebuild is too slow and too risky to bet the quarter on, and the override tool gets multi-site customers something usable inside the 30-day window while the $1.2M in booked pipeline is still live. Circuitway's ARR is $6.1M and gross margin is 71.8%, so keeping the 46% of pipeline that's multi-site actually matters to the growth number the board is watching. I'd ship the override tool, staff it with the two available engineers, and revisit a real model rebuild once we know whether the override tool alone moves the 30-day activation number.
